details.text: Portfolio is temporary canonical source/provenance custody for the active *The Usual Specialists* V2 image work. Live V2 source packages currently cover Index under `src/client/assets/patch/the-usual-specialists/index/` and the route-level temporary lockup under `src/client/assets/patch/the-usual-specialists/under-construction/`; any future page-review candidate must stay in scoped `candidates/` custody until explicit acceptance or abandonment. Detailed human provenance lives under `src/client/assets/patch/the-usual-specialists/provenance/`, each source package's `generation-receipt.json` records genuinely known generation metadata, and `src/client/public/media/patch/the-usual-specialists/usual-specialists-derivatives.json` is the authority for deterministic page-use derivative identity. Linear is migration history only; `provenance/linear-source-register.json` retains only records still represented by live V2 custody.

items: Source/derivative boundary: accepted package PNG masters and explicitly selected page-review candidate PNG masters are durable reproduction inputs, not public site media. `src/client/scripts/process-usual-specialists-assets.mjs` verifies the package manifests, normalized provenance graph, generation receipts and public derivatives. `npm --prefix src/client run media:usual-specialists:apply` is the only derivative writer; `npm --prefix src/client run media:usual-specialists:check` writes nothing and fails on source, provenance, derivative or receipt drift.

Deterministic transform: Sharp 0.34.5 resizes without enlargement at the accepted widths, preserves aspect ratio/alpha, strips metadata, and encodes WebP with `{ quality: 82, alphaQuality: 100, effort: 6, smartSubsample: true }`. Explicit source crops are recorded as deterministic lineage rather than new image-generation events.

Index/opening public derivatives: `src/client/public/media/patch/the-usual-specialists/safehouse-threshold.webp`, `src/client/public/media/patch/the-usual-specialists/index-desktop-base.webp`, `src/client/public/media/patch/the-usual-specialists/index-assent-note.webp` (library-only source retained for historical/material custody), `src/client/public/media/patch/the-usual-specialists/index-blue-carrier.webp`, `src/client/public/media/patch/the-usual-specialists/index-graph-paper.webp`, `src/client/public/media/patch/the-usual-specialists/index-observation.webp`, `src/client/public/media/patch/the-usual-specialists/index-macguffin.webp`, `src/client/public/media/patch/the-usual-specialists/index-outcome-folder.webp`, `src/client/public/media/patch/the-usual-specialists/index-walk.webp`, `src/client/public/media/patch/the-usual-specialists/index-inspect.webp`, `src/client/public/media/patch/the-usual-specialists/index-high-step.webp`, `src/client/public/media/patch/the-usual-specialists/index-return.webp`, `src/client/public/media/patch/the-usual-specialists/patch-follow.webp`, `src/client/public/media/patch/the-usual-specialists/patch-leaning.webp`, and `src/client/public/media/patch/the-usual-specialists/patch-return.webp`.

Retired Silk/rope custody: the previous V2 Silk source package, rope source package, crossing/anchor sources, their generated derivatives and their dedicated provenance records were explicitly retired after the Index checkpoint. They are recoverable from Git history and are not live source authority for the fresh Silk implementation.

Under-construction lockup: `src/client/assets/patch/the-usual-specialists/under-construction/under-construction-patch-lockup.png` is the byte-identical accepted 1536 × 1024 PNG master, SHA-256 `392197a0cf08139f61131eab797a8771ebe90f2570b88e5b7e9d9de030a3b9da`. Its processor-owned page derivative is `src/client/public/media/patch/the-usual-specialists/under-construction-patch-lockup.webp`. The image owns Patch, blank sign, cone, tape and transparent treatment; HTML owns the exact sign copy and React owns responsive placement below the newest completed chapter.

Accepted-but-not-promoted sources are allowed. The normalized provenance/Index generation receipt preserve accepted traversal assets that never entered Portfolio source custody; they are not silently copied into `accepted-assets.json` merely for symmetry.

INDEX outline: `src/client/public/media/patch/the-usual-specialists/index-wordmark.svg` is a byte-for-byte copy of the accepted outlined `index-wordmark-chassis-outline.svg`, SHA-256 `f93278a62975f77eebff4118d2deb2dc08d2270bf7599c4cba0ca663e8df3b22`. Chassis is published only as static SVG outlines: no Chassis font binary, npm font dependency, `@font-face`, encoded font data, machine-local font copy or runtime Chassis font URL belongs in this custody path.

SILK outline keep-piece: `src/client/public/media/patch/the-usual-specialists/silk-wordmark.svg` is a static compound-path outline traced from the locally licensed Chassis Black face, SHA-256 `a6f92737d6459a2ed08dfca80e273456d89b883d01efa558b2a1f874fe6e78ab`. It is intentionally retained for the reusable `SilkNameLockup` with the strapline `PRESSURE | PROVE THE ROUTE`. No Chassis font binary or runtime font dependency enters repository custody.
